chinese: 所以，它是一块面包，上面有些种子。

english: And a lot of mustard and ketchup and onions.
chinese: 嗯，好多芥末、番茄酱和洋葱。

english: I really enjoy hot dogs, but the one thing that I cannot have on a hot dog is mustard or relish.
chinese: 我非常喜欢热狗，但是热狗上不能有黄芥末或者甜面酱。

english: Oh my gosh. Those are the two best things.
chinese: 哦，天啊。那真的是最好的两件事。

english: Okay. I can't talk to you anymore.
chinese: 好的。我不能再和你说话了。

english: Well, tell us what your favorite junk food is and tell Marco that he's crazy
chinese: 好吧，告诉我你的最爱是什么垃圾食品，然后把这个消息告诉马可，让他知道你真的有点疯狂。

english: if he doesn't like mustard.
chinese: 如果他不喜欢芥末。

english: Our website is engluchpod.com.
chinese: 我们的网站是engluchpod.com。

english: Ask us questions as well. We're happy to answer them.
chinese: 问我们问题吧。我们也很乐意回答它们。

english: Until next time. Bye, everyone. Bye.
chinese: 直到下次见。大家再见。
